text:
jordan: async standup — done: finished KMS key inventory for prod-* and uploaded sidetable to s3. Blockers: need approval for cross-account key policy for analytics (legal question about log egress). Today: open PR to tighten IAM roles, kick off vuln scan on images. pls ping if you can review PR #482.

kim: got it — I can review PR after 14:00 PST. For cross-account policy, we should include a short audit trail section. @ravi any quick thoughts? :thumbsup:

ravi: saw the inventory — quick heads up: vuln scan flagged libssl 1.0.2 in one base image. Filed SEC-329 and added remediation steps. Scheduled patching for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. No blocker to rolling out policy once legal signs off.

security-bot: vulnerability scan uploaded: https://internal/reports/SEC-329 — High: 1, Medium: 3, Low: 5. Note: one affected image tag: infra/base:2026-02-18.

anya: FYI I ran a KMS rotation dry-run on staging — rotation flow ok but found one Lambda with hardcoded key ID in env var. Creating a PR to move to Parameter Store and add integration test.

jordan: thanks. @kim can you approve the cross-account policy draft here: https://internal/policies/kms-cross-account? I also plan to test the canary with the new policy at 12:00 UTC. Reminder command for staging dry-run:
```
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id $KEYID --pending-window-in-days 7
```
(do NOT run in prod)

kim: approved the draft, left minor wording comments about principals. I'll review PR #482 later today.

ravi: tagging infra-team — SEC-329 requires rebuilding the base image with updated openssl. @infra-team please build a patched image and coordinate node restarts during the 10:00 UTC window.

infra-team: noted — will produce new image by 08:00 UTC and post the rollout plan in #eng-infra. Will avoid overlapping with DB maintenance.

jordan: great. If no objections, I'll move forward with canary at 12:00 UTC and close this async thread in ~2h. flag here if you need more time.

anya: :+1:
